sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是“隐藏的大脑”。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: The poet Robert Frost wrote about two roads diverging in a yellow wood,
sentences.zh: 诗人罗伯特·弗罗斯特曾写过两条在黄树林中分叉的路，

sentences.en: a moment when a traveler must choose a path, not knowing where either one leads.
sentences.zh: 那是旅行者必须选择一条路的时刻，却不知任何一条路通向何方。

sentences.en: In the poem, the traveler is indecisive, first looking down one path and then another.
sentences.zh: 在诗中，旅行者犹豫不决，先是顺着一条路望去，然后又望向另一条。

sentences.en: The last lines of that poem have become some of the most famous lines in American poetry.
sentences.zh: 这首诗的最后几行已经成为美国诗歌中最著名的诗句。

sentences.en: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I, I took the one less traveled by, and that has made
sentences.zh: 林中分出两条路，而我，我选择了人迹罕至的那一条，这就决定了

sentences.en: all the difference.
sentences.zh: 一切的不同。

sentences.en: Perhaps you've had moments when you've confronted a similar fork in the road.
sentences.zh: 也许你也曾经历过面临类似人生分叉口的时刻。

sentences.en: Should you stay in the city you're living in, or move?
sentences.zh: 你是应该留在你生活的城市，还是搬走？

sentences.en: Should you stay with the person you're with, or leave?
sentences.zh: 你是应该和身边的人在一起，还是离开？

sentences.en: Should you stick with the job you have, or look for a new one?
sentences.zh: 你是应该坚守现在的工作，还是寻找新工作？

sentences.en: Many of us peer down the different paths before us, trying to figure out which one will make
sentences.zh: 我们许多人在眼前的不同道路前凝视，试图弄清楚究竟哪一条能让我们

sentences.en: us happy.
sentences.zh: 感到幸福。

sentences.en: But like that traveler in the woods, we find there isn't enough evidence one way or the other.
sentences.zh: 但就像林中的那个旅行者一样，我们发现无论哪边都没有足够的证据。

sentences.en: We go weeks, months, or years paralyzed by indecision.
sentences.zh: 我们经历了数周、数月甚至数年，被优柔寡断所麻痹。

sentences.en: And then something happens.
sentences.zh: 然后事情发生了。

sentences.en: Maybe it's something big.
sentences.zh: 也许是件大事。

sentences.en: We get a serious medical diagnosis or someone we love dies.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了严重的医疗诊断，或者我们爱的人去世了。

sentences.en: Or maybe it's something small.
sentences.zh: 或者也许是件小事。

sentences.en: You get a traffic ticket or someone looks at you funny.
sentences.zh: 你吃了一张交通罚单，或者有人奇怪地看了你一眼。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, your dilemma is over.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，你的两难困境结束了。

sentences.en: You know which way to go.
sentences.zh: 你知道该走哪条路了。

sentences.en: you know which path to choose.
sentences.zh: 你知道该选择哪条路径了。

sentences.en: Today on the show and in a companion episode on Hidden Brain Plus,
sentences.zh: 今天在节目中以及“隐藏的大脑Plus”的配套剧集中，

sentences.en: we examine the unexpected experiences that give us clarity.
sentences.zh: 我们探讨那些带给我们清晰认知的意外经历。

sentences.en: We look at how and why they are so
sentences.zh: 我们探讨它们为何如此

sentences.en: powerful and we explore techniques to make the best use of these moments.
sentences.zh: 充满力量，并探讨充分利用这些时刻的技巧。

sentences.en: Stepping into the future
sentences.zh: 迈向未来

sentences.en: and leaving the past behind.
sentences.zh: 将过去抛在脑后。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 本周“隐藏的大脑”。

sentences.en: All of our lives are made up by a series
sentences.zh: 我们的一生都是由一系列

sentences.en: of moments.
sentences.zh: 时刻组成的。

sentences.en: Most of them pass by without our notice.
sentences.zh: 它们大多在不知不觉中流逝。

sentences.en: We are busy, or we are on autopilot,
sentences.zh: 我们很忙，或者处于自动驾驶状态，

sentences.en: or we are paying attention to something else.
sentences.zh: 或者我们在关注别的事情。

sentences.en: But all of us also have moments that stand out.
sentences.zh: 但我们所有人也都有一些脱颖而出的时刻。

sentences.en: At these times, you can suddenly see your own life clearly.
sentences.zh: 在这些时刻，你能突然清晰地看到自己的人生。

sentences.en: You know what to do going forward.
sentences.zh: 你知道接下来该做什么。

sentences.en: At University College London, psychologist Anthony Clarke studies these moments.
sentences.zh: 在伦敦大学学院，心理学家安东尼·克拉克研究这些时刻。

sentences.en: He spent years examining how they inform what we do and how they can reveal whom we want to become.
sentences.zh: 他花了多年时间研究这些时刻如何塑造我们的行为，以及它们如何揭示我们想成为什么样的人。

sentences.en: Anthony Klotz, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·克洛茨，欢迎来到“隐藏的大脑”。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Anthony, I want to start with an experience that you had all the way back in high school.
sentences.zh: 安东尼，我想从你远在高中时的一段经历开始说起。

sentences.en: You worked part-time at a lumberyard with a friend.
sentences.zh: 你和朋友在一个木材厂兼职工作。

sentences.en: What was the work like?
sentences.zh: 那里的工作是什么样的？

sentences.en: Yeah, so it was on the evenings and weekends of my senior year of high school.
sentences.zh: 对，那是我高三的晚上和周末。

sentences.en: I worked in a lumberyard where customers would come in and ask for their two-by-fours to be cut to certain lengths
sentences.zh: 我在一家木材厂工作，顾客会进来要求把他们的两乘四木材切割成特定长度，

sentences.en: or their plywood to be cut in certain shapes.
sentences.zh: 或者把胶合板切割成特定形状。

sentences.en: And it was my job to help them get what they needed for whatever home improvement task they were taking on.
sentences.zh: 我的工作就是帮助他们获得他们正在进行的任何家居装修任务所需的东西。

sentences.en: So I understand that you and a friend were doing this work together.
sentences.zh: 所以我了解到你和一个朋友一起做这项工作。

sentences.en: Was it a good work environment?
sentences.zh: 那里的工作环境好吗？

sentences.en: What was the boss like?
sentences.zh: 老板是什么样的人？

sentences.en: It was a really fun work environment.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常有趣的工作环境。

sentences.en: And I did work there with my good friend.
sentences.zh: 我和我的好朋友一起在那儿工作。

sentences.en: And that made the hours pass quickly along with the work.
sentences.zh: 这让漫长的时间和工作都过得很快。

sentences.en: Our boss, as he probably needed to be managing young students in a lumberyard, was pretty strict and stern.
sentences.zh: 我们的老板，因为他管理木材厂的年轻学生可能确实需要这样，相当严格和严厉。

sentences.en: But that didn't really bother us.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有真正困扰我们。

sentences.en: It was a good work environment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的工作环境。

sentences.en: I enjoyed it.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢。

sentences.en: So at one point over the summer, both you and your friend needed some time off.
sentences.zh: 所以在夏天的一个时候，你和你的朋友都需要请假。

sentences.en: And that led to something very interesting.
sentences.zh: 这导致了一件非常有趣的事情。

sentences.en: Tell me the story of what happened.
sentences.zh: 告诉我发生了什么的故事。

sentences.en: Yeah, so both my friend and I got called into the office one day by the boss.
sentences.zh: 好的，有一天我和朋友都被老板叫进了办公室。

sentences.en: And he informed us that we had both requested vacation at the same time.
sentences.zh: 他通知我们，我们俩同时申请了假期。

sentences.en: And he said, one of you has to work here.
sentences.zh: 他说，你们俩必须有一个人留在这里工作。

sentences.en: You can't both take vacation at the same time.
sentences.zh: 你们不能同时休假。

sentences.en: But we explained we both had these separate family events that we needed to attend.
sentences.zh: 但我们解释说，我们都有这些需要参加的不同的家庭活动。

sentences.en: And so both of us sat there in an impasse saying we both need to take this time off.
sentences.zh: 于是我们俩坐在那里陷入了僵局，都说我们需要休这段假。

sentences.en: I'm wondering how you heard this request from your boss that either you or your friend had to work.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是怎么听到老板提出的“你或你的朋友必须工作”这个要求的。

sentences.en: How did that come across to you, Anthony?
sentences.zh: 安东尼，你对此有何感想？

sentences.en: It was somewhat surprising.
sentences.zh: 这有点令人惊讶。

sentences.en: I mean, I sort of empathized with him.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我某种程度上同情他。

sentences.en: He's trying to cover the shifts that are available and we're two of the main workers.
sentences.zh: 他试图填补可用的班次，而我们是两个主力工人。

sentences.en: But at the same time, I could tell that we both had events.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我能看出我们俩都有活动。

sentences.en: We weren't going to move.
sentences.zh: 我们是不会让步的。

sentences.en: And so in my head as it was happening, I was wondering sort of how this was going to play
sentences.zh: 所以在事情发生时我脑子里在想，这究竟会如何

sentences.en: out both with him and my friend.
sentences.zh: 在我、老板和我朋友之间展开。

sentences.en: How did it turn out?
sentences.zh: 结果怎么样？

sentences.en: Well, neither of us budged.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们谁也没有让步。

sentences.en: And our boss sort of got frustrated.
sentences.zh: 我们的老板有点沮丧。

sentences.en: And eventually he accused or said, I think the two of you planned this together.
sentences.zh: 最后他指责或说，我想你们两个是一起策划的。

sentences.en: Like you're going somewhere to goof off or something like that.
sentences.zh: 就像你们要去什么地方偷懒或者类似的事情。

sentences.en: And at that moment, it sort of flipped
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，事情发生了转变，

sentences.en: because it seemed like maybe he was accusing us of lying
sentences.zh: 因为似乎他可能是在指责我们撒谎，

sentences.en: or there was some trust breakdown here.
sentences.zh: 或者这里的信任崩溃了。

sentences.en: So there was this awkward silence.
sentences.zh: 于是出现了一阵尴尬的沉默。

sentences.en: And then almost at the same time, my friend and I said,
sentences.zh: 然后几乎在同一时间，我和朋友说：

sentences.en: I quit.
sentences.zh: 我不干了。

sentences.en: And we took off our hard hats and unclipped our measuring tape
sentences.zh: 我们摘下安全帽，解下卷尺，

sentences.en: and handed it to our boss and said, that's it, we're done.
sentences.zh: 把它交给了老板，说就这样吧，我们不干了。

sentences.en: It's almost like one of those Hollywood moments, right,
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像好莱坞的那些时刻，对吧，

sentences.en: when the worker is really frustrated
sentences.zh: 当工人感到非常沮丧时，

sentences.en: and basically flings their pass down at the boss
sentences.zh: 基本上把通行证摔在老板面前，

sentences.en: and walks out the door.
sentences.zh: 然后摔门而出。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: I mean, the stakes weren't incredibly high
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，风险并没有那么高，

sentences.en: because this was a high school job,
sentences.zh: 因为这是一份高中工作，

sentences.en: but nonetheless, it did have a little bit
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，它确实带有一点

sentences.en: of a Hollywood quality to it.
sentences.zh: 好莱坞式的特质。

sentences.zh: 许多年之后，安东尼，

sentences.en: you were working for the food company General Mills.
sentences.zh: 你在食品公司通用磨坊工作。

sentences.en: For listeners who are not familiar with the company,
sentences.zh: 对于不熟悉这家公司的听众来说，

sentences.en: describe the range of things the company does
sentences.zh: 请描述一下该公司经营的业务范围，

sentences.en: and what your role was at the company.
sentences.zh: 以及你在公司担任的角色。

sentences.en: Yes, so it's a food manufacturing
sentences.zh: 好的，这是一家食品制造

sentences.en: and marketing company.
sentences.zh: 和营销公司。

sentences.en: Most people know it best because of the cereals that they make, like Cheerios, but they also own a number of other food brands, Old El Paso and Betty Crocker and so forth.
sentences.zh: 大多数人最了解它是通过他们生产的麦片，比如谷维滋（Cheerios），但他们还拥有许多其他食品品牌，如老艾尔帕索（Old El Paso）和贝蒂妙厨（Betty Crocker）等等。

sentences.en: And so I worked in food manufacturing, and so I worked in a variety of different food manufacturing plants that made different products.
sentences.zh: 所以我从事食品制造工作，我在生产不同产品的各种食品制造厂工作过。

sentences.en: I understand that at one point your job was to make sure there were enough ingredients at each of the plants to make products like Lucky Charms and Cheerios.
sentences.zh: 我了解到，你曾有一段时间的工作是确保每个工厂有足够的原料来制作幸运魅力麦片（Lucky Charms）和谷维滋（Cheerios）等产品。

sentences.en: and I'm guessing that one of the essential ingredients for these plants to function was
sentences.zh: 我猜这些工厂运转必不可少的原料之一是

sentences.zh: 面粉，而且可能数量很大。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.zh: 我刚毕业的第一份工作，

sentences.en: first job out of school was to be inbound planner for a cereal plant, and the main ingredient in
sentences.zh: 有一段时间担任麦片厂的进货规划师，而麦片的主要成分

sentences.zh: 就是面粉。

sentences.zh: 因此，作为进货规划师，我的头号工作就是不能用光面粉。

sentences.zh: 所以在做这份工作的过程中发生了一件事，在某种程度上对

sentences.zh: 你的人生产生了重大影响。

sentences.zh: 告诉我发生了什么。

sentences.zh: 所以这是一份

sentences.zh: 因此，

sentences.zh: 我自认为是一个相当不错的规划师。

sentences.zh: 但当我真正担任这个角色时，我试图

sentences.zh: 将库存保持在非常紧缩的水平。

sentences.zh: 但是有一种原料

sentences.zh: 很难快速替换，那就是面粉，因为它是通过缓慢的火车车厢运来的。

sentences.en: And so while I was running
sentences.zh: 因此，在我保持

sentences.en: Wait, the whole plant had to shut down?
sentences.zh: 等等，整个工厂都得停工？

sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So we're talking tens of thousands of dollars
sentences.zh: 所以由于我的库存管理做法，

sentences.en: in cost because of my inventory management practices.

sentences.en: I mean, the main feeling that I had
sentences.zh: 我的主要感受

sentences.en: was embarrassment and shame over, you know, there were a lot of people counting on this plant for
sentences.zh: 是尴尬和羞愧，你知道，有很多人指望这家工厂谋生，还有很多人指望它提供早餐。

sentences.en: early career failure.

sentences.zh: 我真的擅长

sentences.zh: 我最终做出了改变，在职业生涯的早期

sentences.zh: 所以，我本来不是要去

sentences.zh: 搬去那儿生活很长一段时间，结果我却接受了调职，去了加利福尼亚州的洛迪，

sentences.zh: 那么安东尼，你在隆巴德和通用磨坊的经历表明，

sentences.zh: 利物浦足球俱乐部的主教练，

sentences.en: and was arguably one of the greatest managers,
